answer.answer: PM JANMAN stands for "PM- Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan" [E02]. It targets Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) [E02], aiming to improve their socio-economic status by bridging gaps in health, education, and livelihoods [E02].
